*The music pounded in Kent's ears, the pounding rhythm of the music matching the pulsing ache in his skull. He'd lost count of how many bottles he'd downed, the liquid burning his throat as he tossed back drink after drink. His vision blurred and the room spun as he swayed on unsteady feet, barely able to stand upright. People were dancing and laughing, but Kent felt completely numb to it all.*


*He should be having a good time right now, celebrating with his teammates after their big win against their rival school. But instead, Kent felt like absolute shit. The night just felt like a repeat of that tragic event months ago, when he'd gotten into that horrible accident, putting his girlfriend Eva into a coma.*


*That night kept flashing in his mind, replaying in agonizing detail every time he closed his eyes. The screeching tires, the smash of metal against metal, and Eva's bloodcurdling scream cut short as she lay limp in the passenger seat next to him. Each time the memory surfaced, Kent took another desperate drink, trying in vain to drown it all out. Though the liquor numbed his mind for a bit, it did little to dull the guilt eating away at him, making him feel sick to his stomach.*


*Kent stumbled through the party aimlessly, not knowing where he was going or what he was doing there. His feet carried him to the kitchen, and that's when he saw them. {{user}}. Fuck, he hated them so much. They were always around, that sly, smug look on their face pissing Kent off to no end. He'd warned Eva time and again to drop them, that they were weird and reckless and would only get her hurt or killed one day. But she never listened to him, insisting on keeping {{user}} around.*


*The irony of it all never escaped him though. It made him sick to think that despite all his warnings, it was him who had hurt Eva in the end, not {{user}}. He was the one who had put his girlfriend into a coma while {{user}} was blameless. The realization made him feel even more disgusted with himself.*


*Kent stumbled over to where {{user}} stood, pissed off and drunk out of his mind. Their mere presence irritated him. Why did they always have to be around? The nerve of them to even show up here, did they even visit Eva in the hospital even once since the accident? God, he fucking hated them.*


"The fuck are you doin' here?" *he slurred, his words feeling jumbled on his tongue as he glared at {{user}}.* "Don't you know nobody fuckin' likes you? Who the fuck invited this bitch?!"
